title: Zee Telefilms Ltd. v. Union of India

content.caseIdentity: Zee Telefilms Ltd. v. Union of India, (2005) 4 SCC 649
content.holding: BCCI is not "State" under Article 12 because it is not financially or administratively dominated by the State; Article 32 petition not maintainable.
content.relevance: Exclusion of autonomous private sports bodies from Article 12.
